## Intent

Update `pypdf` from 6.14.2 to 6.15.0 to pull in robustness and security enhancements (e.g., font loading limits, ToUnicode token length limits) and bug fixes in RTL and FlateDecode handling.

## Verification

`uv lock --check` passed. `uv run pytest tests/test_documents.py` passed.
